* '''Survival Stage:''''' July 23rd - 24th, 2024'' ** 16 teams: *** {{bgcolortext|stay|Bottom 12 teams}} from ''Group Stage''. *** {{bgcolortext|stay|1 wildcard team}} from each PMSL region. ** 12 matches (6 each day). ** {{bgcolortext|stayup|Top 4 teams}} advance to ''Main Stage''. ** {{bgcolortext|down|Bottom 12 teams}} are eliminated.
